title: SepsisExamExtraction
description: Extract the three Quick SOFA inputs a bedside sepsis screen needs, from a free-text clinical note. The output is the exact payload the sepsis-screening contract consumes.

x-notes.propertyOrder: LOAD-BEARING. The order is the order the prompt lists them, and the grammar compiles it: respiratory rate, then systolic blood pressure, then GCS — the order medprotocol takes its --rr, --sbp and --gcs.
x-notes.allRequired: All three are required and none may be omitted or reported as unassessed. medprotocol's `sepsis qsofa` refuses a missing criterion, and a screen missing one is a screen that never ran, so a partial payload must fail here rather than be scored.

respiratory_rate.description: Respiratory rate in breaths per minute

gcs.description: Glasgow Coma Scale total, 3 to 15. A patient described as alert and oriented with no mention of a measured score is 15.
